title: Explainable Prediction of High-Speed Solar Wind Streams driven by Coronal Holes via Topological Data Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.35549v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-speed solar wind streams (HSSs) originating from coronal holes (CHs) are an important driver of recurrent geomagnetic activity. Since HSSs are associated to coronal structures visible in extreme-ultraviolet observations, this provides a natural basis for forecasting several days in advance. In this work, we investigate whether the topology of coronal structures observed in extreme ultraviolet (EUV) images contains predictive information on the subsequent occurrence of CH-driven HSSs at Earth. To this end, we consider Topological Data Analysis (TDA), and in particular persistent homology, to classify EUV solar images according to the occurrence of HSSs at Earth four days later. The target is a binary classification of HSS occurrence at a four-day lead time, defined using an HSS interval catalog and solar wind speed thresholds. Several combinations of topological representations and classifiers are evaluated under a common cross-val

translated_title: 基于拓扑数据分析的冕洞驱动高速太阳风流的可解释预测
translated_abstract: 源自冕洞的高速太阳风流是重现性地磁活动的重要驱动因素。由于高速太阳风流与极紫外观测中可见的日冕结构相关联，这为提前数天进行预报提供了天然基础。在本研究中，我们探究在极紫外图像中观测到的日冕结构的拓扑特性是否包含关于随后地球处冕洞驱动高速太阳风流发生的预测信息。为此，我们采用拓扑数据分析方法，特别是持续同调，根据地球四天后高速太阳风流的发生情况对极紫外太阳图像进行分类。任务目标是在四天提前期上对高速太阳风流的发生进行二元分类，该分类基于高速太阳风流区间目录和太阳风速度阈值来定义。研究在统一的交叉验证框架下评估了多种拓扑表示与分类器的组合。
tldr: 本文创新性地利用拓扑数据分析（持续同调）从极紫外太阳图像中提取日冕结构的拓扑特征，实现了对四天后冕洞驱动高速太阳风流的可解释预测。
en_tdlr: This paper innovatively applies topological data analysis (persistent homology) to extract topological features of coronal structures from EUV solar images, achieving explainable prediction of coronal-hole-driven high-speed solar wind streams four days in advance.
